subject: CPPO setup with CloudScale Partners — pricing and DocuSign
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aimee Chen <aimee.chen@amazon.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudscalepartners.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Hi Aimee + Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro earlier this week. CloudScale has a live procurement conversation with BigRetailCo and we want to route the purchase through CloudScale via an AWS Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO). Goal is to get a private offer in place with the following constraints:

- Redwood list price per vCPU-month: see attached redwood-pricing-CPPO-v2.xlsx (tab: CPPO list)
- Target reseller margin: 12% net to reseller (CloudScale)
- Contract term: 12 months, standard Redwood SOW & T&Cs (attached redwood-cppo-term-sheet.pdf)
- We need CPPO visible to BigRetailCo and the buyer PO to remain intact for them to submit to AWS

Aimee — can you kick off the CPPO creation and confirm whether AWS needs any additional fields (seller partner id, reseller margin override, billing contact) from our side? Jordan — if you can confirm the margin and reseller billing contact at CloudScale, we can finalize the DocuSign flow.

I attached the term sheet and the current CPPO pricing spreadsheet. If possible, please get back with the expected timeline (AWS creation + partner acceptance) — BigRetailCo expects procurement next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: redwood-cppo-term-sheet.pdf (term sheet), redwood-pricing-CPPO-v2.xlsx (pricing)

From: Aimee Chen <aimee.chen@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudscalepartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Hi Marissa, Jordan — happy to help.

Quick answers:
- AWS needs the Partner (reseller) AWS Account ID and the Partner Type (Channel) filled in when we create the CPPO.
- We can set the reseller margin as a percent off the seller list price in our backend, but procurement occasionally asks for the "Net Seller Price" field in the private offer payload; include both in your sheet.
- Please include billing contact (name + email) for CloudScale — we'll use that for invoicing metadata.

Timeline: if you provide the Partner AWS Account ID and confirm final pricing by Monday EOD PT, I can submit the CPPO draft the same day. Partner acceptance typically takes 24–72 hours depending on their internal signing process.

I attached the AWS CPPO instructions for your reference.

Cheers,
Aimee
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
aimee.chen@amazon.com

Attachments: aws-cppo-instructions.pdf

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudscalepartners.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aimee Chen <aimee.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: partners@cloudscalepartners.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Marissa / Aimee,

Thanks — CloudScale can accept a 12% margin; billing contact below:
- Name: Dana Rios
- Email: dana.rios@cloudscalepartners.com
- AWS Partner Account ID: 123456789012

Two quick asks from our side: can Redwood provide the expected renewal uplift assumption to include in our internal pricing model (we usually model +5% annual uplift), and will Redwood accept EDI/PO-based invoicing (Net 30)?

We can sign the private offer once the DocuSign link includes the reseller as the purchasing partner. Send the DocuSign to partners@cloudscalepartners.com and cc: dana.rios@cloudscalepartners.com.

Jordan
VP, Channel Sales | CloudScale Partners
jordan.mills@cloudscalepartners.com | +1 206-555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudscalepartners.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Aimee Chen <aimee.chen@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Jordan — thanks for the info. Quick internal notes:
- Renewal uplift: we typically model +3–5% depending on list pricing changes; for BigRetailCo let's lock at +4% for the 12 month term and review at renewal.
- Invoicing: Redwood can support EDI/PO-based invoicing through our finance team. Aditya, can you confirm Net 30 terms and whether there are any exceptions for channel invoices?

Vivek — can you confirm capacity/throughput commitments in the term sheet? BigRetailCo will want an SLA paragraph included in the CPPO attachments (they care about 95th percentile latency for inference).

I'll draft the DocuSign envelope once Aditya confirms Net 30 and Vivek confirms SLA language.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aimee Chen <aimee.chen@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Marissa / team,

Net 30 with EDI/PO-based invoicing is acceptable for channel invoices; finance requests that CloudScale include a PO reference on each invoice (we will validate against the CPPO offer id). We also require a primary billing contact (Dana looks good).

On SLA: Vivek, please provide the SLA paragraph (95th percentile inference latency target + credits) so we can include a short summary in the term sheet. Legal asks that the CPPO reference our master services agreement (MSA) and not include custom indemnities for this reseller flow.

I'll validate once DocuSign envelope is prepared.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO request — CloudScale reseller margin and pricing

Marissa / Jordan,

SLA paragraph for inclusion: 
"Redwood Inference will provide production inference service with a target 95th percentile latency of < 250ms for single-turn text generation workloads up to 2k tokens, measured at the account-level across a 30-day rolling window. In the event Redwood fails to meet the guaranteed latency target for three or more days in a calendar month, Redwood will provide service credits equal to 5% of that month's invoice for the affected account. Credits are capped at 15% of monthly invoice. This SLA applies to requests routed to Redwood-hosted endpoints specified in the CPPO and does not cover customer-managed private deployments or network transit delays beyond Redwood control."

That should be sufficient for procurement; we can tighten the numbers if BigRetailCo pushes back.

Vivek
Head of Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
